# Pinned Chromium revision for Halcyon integration.
#
# This file is the single source of truth for which Chromium revision the
# Halcyon integration patches in patches/ target. The patches are
# generated by scripts/generate_patches.py against this revision.
#
# To build Halcyon:
#   1. Download the source tarball at HALCYON_CHROMIUM_TARBALL_URL.
#   2. Apply the Halcyon source tree (rsync halcyon/src/ into the
#      Chromium src/ tree).
#   3. Apply the patches in patches/ in the order documented in
#      patches/README.md.
#   4. Run `gn gen out/Halcyon --args='...'` with enable_halcyon=true.
#   5. Run `ninja -C out/Halcyon chrome`.
#
# To re-pin to a newer Chromium revision:
#   1. Verify the new revision has an official source tarball at
#      https://commondatastorage.googleapis.com/chromium-browser-official/
#      (the tarball is ~5 GB and saves ~22 GB of disk vs gclient sync).
#   2. Update this file with the new SHA + version + tarball URL.
#   3. Update PINNED_SHA, PINNED_VERSION, PINNED_TARBALL_URL in
#      scripts/generate_patches.py.
#   4. Run `python3 scripts/generate_patches.py` to regenerate the patches
#      against the new revision.
#   5. Run `bash scripts/verify_patches.sh` to confirm the new patches apply.

# The full 40-character SHA-1 of the pinned Chromium commit.
HALCYON_CHROMIUM_SHA=f0ad4fd4ee3dc3ff81e176260e3f1bf441937d29

# The Chromium version string (MAJOR.MINOR.BUILD.PATCH) at that SHA.
HALCYON_CHROMIUM_VERSION=159.0.8141.0

# The branch / tag the SHA was on at pin time.
HALCYON_CHROMIUM_TAG=refs/tags/159.0.8141.0

# The date the pin was made (ISO 8601, UTC).
HALCYON_PIN_DATE=2026-11-04T01:00:00Z

# The official source tarball URL. Used by scripts/fetch_source.sh.
# This is ~5 GB compressed and saves ~22 GB of disk vs `gclient sync`.
HALCYON_CHROMIUM_TARBALL_URL=https://commondatastorage.googleapis.com/chromium-browser-official/chromium-159.0.8141.0.tar.xz

# The short SHA (12 characters) for display.
HALCYON_CHROMIUM_SHA_SHORT=f0ad4fd4ee3d
